INK_BASE_INK_LASH.label: Ink Lash
INK_BASE_INK_LASH.why: One creature or object you can see: use the native ranged Cultivation Attack, printed CL-scaled d8 plus key modifier, chosen Slashing or Psychic damage, and ordinary object defenses. Discretionary cutting, staining, writing and weakening remain the GM's decision; no automatic lock opening or disintegration.
